rules.recommendation: Use Vitamin C in AM, Retinol in PM
rules.reason: Both are potent actives with different optimal pH levels. Separating them protects the skin barrier and reduces irritation risk.

rules.recommendation: Alternate nights or use BHA in AM and Retinol in PM
rules.reason: Both accelerate cellular turnover and can compromise the lipid barrier when layered together.
Layering potent AHAs with retinoids substantially elevates trans-epidermal water loss and flaking.

rules.recommendation: Avoid combining directly in the same routine
rules.reason: Benzoyl peroxide can oxidize and deactivate retinol formulations, while causing severe localized dryness.

rules.recommendation: Use combined formulations only, or alternate usage frequency
rules.reason: Dual chemical exfoliants can over-strip delicate stratum corneum if not buffered by humectants.

rules.recommendation: Safe to use together in modern formulations
rules.reason: Historical incompatibility claims applied to high-heat laboratory conditions. Modern buffered serums work synergistically.

rules.recommendation: Excellent synergistic pairing for pore control and sebum regulation
rules.reason: Niacinamide calms inflammation while BHA clears pore debris.

rules.recommendation: Ideal pairing: apply Hyaluronic Acid to buffer and hydrate
rules.reason: Humectants replenish moisture drawn out by active retinization.
Ceramides reinforce the intercellular matrix against potential retinoid irritation.

rules.recommendation: Gentle dual-action for hyperpigmentation and redness
rules.reason: Both inhibit melanosome transfer and soothe erythema through non-competing mechanisms.

mandatory_pairings.reason: Photosensitizing actives increase UV vulnerability; broad-spectrum SPF 50+ is essential.
